name: study-zone
description: Study Zone web workspace and Capacitor Android app.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check offline-sync.js && node --check native-shell.js && node --check service-worker.js && node --check server.js && node tests/static-checks.js && node tests/platform-checks.js && node scripts/i18n-audit.js
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
